lines.en: label saraspring7:
scene noonsky
Now that I’ve managed to seamlessly weave Yuki Yamaguchi’s sad existence back into my mutually sad life, I figure it only makes sense to go after her daughter next.

And by...go after I mean track her down. Unless that sounds even more predatory. To which I’d just say imagine I’m out here to find Yumi and teach her about math or something because she probably needs it.
But I guess this probably won’t be the place to find her anymore on account of the whole “having a job” thing and that I’m likely just going to run into Io instead.
: Sensei?
scene saranoonwalk1
Or apparently Sara, who isn’t even in the same age group as the last two girls I mentioned, but is still very cute regardless.
: You’re not Yumi.
: No, but sometimes I wish I was because it would make Yuki like me more. What are you doing over here?
scene saranoonwalk2
: In fact, what are you doing in public to begin with? I’ve seen TikToks about you. You know it’s not safe out here now that you’re dating a celebrity, right?
: I was perfectly fine when I went to the bar the other night.
: Sure, but you had Yuki to protect you back then. And if you’re hoping I’m going to be able to protect you this time, I have very bad news.
: Plus, the bar is a controlled environment. And if you-
scene saranoonwalk3
: Wait! What if I made a video advertising the bar while you were inside? People might flock to the store thinking they could take pictures of you or something!
: Please don’t leverage my childhood friend’s fame to boost sales. I think that’s immoral, I just can’t explain why.
scene saranoonwalk4
: Fine. But only because I like knowing a side of you the paparazzi don’t. And probably shouldn’t because you are not exactly the most morally good man I’ve never known.
: Better me than a teenager, though.
scene saranoonwalk5
: Unless the paparazzi think I am a teenager and we’re in the midst of developing a scandal...Oh no. How horrible would that be?
: Just get off the Internet entirely and stop thinking about any of that stuff. That’s how I’ve been coping with it.
scene saranoonwalk6
: Is it really coping if that’s how you’ve always been, though?
: Who says I haven’t been coping my entire life?

: Fair point. But if I didn’t use the Internet, I wouldn’t have seen all of those cute childhood pictures of you and Niki and start secretly cheering for you guys while my jealousy meter skyrockets behind the scenes.
: You make it sound like there’s been more than just the one.
: Oh, you haven’t heard? She posted a bunch more when her agency tried to brush it under the rug. They’re all over the place now.
: What? When? Why?
: Why don’t you just ask her?
: Because she’s scary and mad at me for extremely reasonable...reasons. And I’ve decided it’s best to just let her do whatever she wants without getting in her way for now.

: Well, thank you for that. Because I now have a bunch of pictures saved of little Akira and I love him. It makes me wish I had a childhood friend to fall in love with back then instead of a manipulative adult.
: Just be glad you didn’t have both because it would lay the groundwork for ruining the rest of your life.
: I think if anything, this ruins Niki’s more than yours.
: Thank you, Sara. That is exactly what I wanted to hear right now.
scene saranoonwalk7
: That...came out way worse than I meant for it to come out! I’m sorry! I...actually think it’s adorable how she threw her career away for you! It means she really loves you and-
: I get it. And it’s fine.
scene saranoonwalk8
: It’s just...all she’s ever done is throw things away for me. So it only makes sense that that’s how she’d try and go out in the end.

: Mnh...I feel like the more I talk about this, the worse I’m making everything. And it’s becoming increasingly difficult to figure out how to get you to invite her to the bar so I can fangirl over her.
: Oh, right. I forgot you were a fan.
scene saranoonwalk9
: That’s why I went out shopping, actually. I wanted to see if I could get a CD or something before they were all pulled from the shelves, but it seems like everywhere’s already been cleared out.
: I even asked the music shop at the mall and they said the entire stock was bought out by one girl. Idol fans can be really terrifying sometimes, huh?
: I get all that. What I don’t get is how you wound up with a leek in the bag.
scene saranoonwalk10
: I didn’t want to go home empty-handed and it was on sale.
: Would you like me to get you a Niki CD, Sara?
: It’s fine. Just let me borrow her for a little while instead. That much should be fine after all the free drinks I’ve given you, right?
: I guess. I’m just surprised that you waited so long to make me settle my tab like this when you’ve known I’ve been dating her for years now.
: I’ve been holding this in for a long time. But if Niki’s going to crash out, I think it’s only fair that I get to crash out too.
: Lunch?
: I was wondering when you were going to ask.
scene saranoonwalk11
We walk past where the sidewalk ends and begin to make our way to a local diner. And, as has become customary as of late, there’s no shortage of people taking pictures.
Gossiping.
Asking who this girl is and why I’m not with Niki. Calling me names. Calling Sara names. And it’s just something I’m going to have to live with now.
I’m emotionally detached enough to not really register this is a problem or something to be offended by...but I can’t help but worry about how Sara is going to interpret all of it.
I just don’t want our entire relationship needing to occur within the walls of her own home now. But if being out in public with her is going to subject to her to this then...
I guess it might have to.
I guess this is just how things are now.
: Sorry about all of the...everything.
: How did you guess the title of my autobiography?
: What do you need to apologize for? You’re only getting insulted because you’re out and about with me.

: Oh, that doesn’t bother me at all. I was called way worse in high school once word got around that I was sleeping with a teacher. And that’s not even counting all my parents said to me on a daily basis.
: Sure, but none of that’s anything you should apologize for.

: Maybe not to you. But I brought children into this world. And now Sana has to live with the fact that her mother was, once upon a time, a foolish and lovesick moron. My background alone taints her existence.
: I don’t think Sana would agree with that, to be honest.
: No, neither do I. But I do think she won’t ever look at me the same way other girls look at their moms.
: I’m sure she’s glad she has a mom to look at in general when half of her classmates just don’t.
: I hope you’re right about that. It still kills me that Ayane’s mom walked out on her. She’d probably think twice if she could see her now.
: Is it Ayane appreciation time? I can get behind that.
: How’s she taking all of this? The Niki stuff, I mean.
: Because you two have always been really close, and I can’t imagine it’s good. But she seemed to just shrug it off when I saw her the other night, and that confused me.
: Ayane has bigger issues to worry about right now. And she’s also known about Niki for a long time, so I imagine this is just more of the same for her.
: You imagine? So you guys haven’t talked about it yet?
: We’re...having a hard time talking at all lately. Things feel...weird. And neither one of us can figure out why.
: Weird how?
: It’s like a...nauseous feeling we’re getting, almost. That same sort of feeling you get when you can’t remember if you left the stove on.
: I’ve been feeling that since I went out this morning.
: Do you want to stop at the bar first then?
: No. This is the closest I’ve ever been to feeling like a celebrity and I don’t want it to end yet.
scene saranoonwalk12
: I really think you two should talk about it, though. Maybe put on your dad-pants and sit her down on something that isn’t your lap for once.
: I’d love to. But Ayane’s never been as open with me as I’d like her to be. If anything, I think Sana would have a better shot at getting through to her right now than I would.
scene saranoonwalk13
: I can see why you’d feel that way, but Sana’s not exactly the best when it comes to discussing...serious issues either.
: I agree. She and Ayane are still like sisters at the end of the day, though.
scene saranoonwalk14
: Sisters, huh?...
: Oh, shit. Should I not have-
: No, you’re fine...I’m...
: I’m glad she has someone like that again. And I’m glad it’s Ayane. She’s a good influence.
: I just...
: I worry that the years she spent without a...sibling...might have turned her into something I just can’t really...parent the way I want to, you know?
: Yeah...both of our kids lost someone extremely important to them. And both are permanently damaged because of it. But hey, at least Sana isn’t threatening to kill everyone you love.
scene saranoonwalk15
: Is Ami really doing that? But she’s such a sweetheart. I can’t imagine that at all.
: Weirdly enough, I actually think you might be spared all the potential bloodshed. Ami’s always really liked you for some reason.
scene saranoonwalk16
: Do I remind her of her mom, maybe? I’ve always been afraid to really talk about that with her since I just don’t know enough about their relationship and...what happened.
: I don’t think that’s it. But even...I don’t know much about Ami’s relationship with her mom since my presence in her life sort of...tapered off after Ami was born.
: You have the same amount of love to give, though. Almost too much. And it’s that...unwavering sort of love that I just...
: I don’t know. This isn’t really the place to-
: Akira, are you trying to tell me your love for Ami is wavering?
: That’s...I don’t know. It feels that way sometimes...
: She’s just...she’s difficult in a way I don’t know how to handle. And I thought having Niki around would change that, but-
: Having a woman around the house won’t do anything to change your feelings for your daughter.

: I get that she’s difficult and that it might be scary figuring out how to confront her when you need to, but surely that doesn’t change how you feel as a whole, right? I’ve seen how much you love her firsthand.
: Hell, we even went camping to prove it. There’s no way in hell I’d be able to drag you out to go camping under normal circumstances.
: I know. And I do love her. I just...
: I feel like she isn’t really herself at times. And it’s like talking to a completely different person. That’s when my feelings start to waver.
if sarasex == True:
: A...different person? Or a different person?
: A different person.
scene saranoonwalk17
: You don’t...
: You don’t think she might be going through what we did, do you? The blackouts...seeing things...
: I have no idea...And by that I mean I do have an idea. I just can’t seem to talk to her about it because she’s always doing something fucking crazy.
: Right. But if that’s what you mean when you say she isn’t acting like herself, don’t you think it makes it more important than ever to give her all of the love you possibly can?
: Because you know exactly how scary those moments can be, Akira. You know how powerless it feels to lose yourself. Which means Ami’s probably scared too.
: Well...she sure doesn’t act like it. And that’s why it’s been so hard to really...give her the affection she needs.
scene saranoonwalk18

: Like, I obviously do love her. And I want to love all of her. But there’s something inside of me that’s almost holding me back from doing that. Like she’s...threatening my entire existence or something.
: Would you like me to talk to her then? As someone apparently safe from the potential bloodshed, as you put it?
: Maybe she’s just scared because she thinks she’s alone? That no one else has ever experienced what she’s going through and that’s what makes it hard to talk.
: I’ve put you through enough trouble as-is, Sara. I can’t keep relying on you to sub in whenever I can’t break through to my own daughter.
scene saranoonwalk19

: Well, this is normally where I’d tell you to marry me and that this problem would be solved if I was just her mother, but I think you’ve made it very clear that Niki is closer to that than I will ever be.
: Which is not something I should be jealous about given that she is better than me in basically every single category, but I am jealous nonetheless.
: Would you talk to her, please?
scene saranoonwalk20
: Niki or Ami? Which one are we talking about now? Because I need to prepare if I’m going to meet an idol. I don’t want her to think I’m boring.
: Ami. Fix her and I’ll let you borrow Niki for an entire week.
scene saranoonwalk21
: That’s enough time to watch all of Supernatural together...
: If that’s what you want to use her for, fine. Just help me out, please. I don’t know what else to do and it really does seem like you’re the only girl Ami-
scene saranoonwalk22
: Akira, you really don’t need to thank me. I’d do this even if you didn’t ask.
: I know what it’s like not having parents to rely on. Which is why I’ll always be there for any confused kid who needs me. Not just Ami.
: She’s just the one who happens to need the most help right now.
: Have her drop by the bar soon. Tell her you need her to pick something up. Or just that I want to talk to her if you don’t think she’ll find that weird.
: I don’t think she’d find it weird at all. Unless her attitude toward you is just one more long-con and that she secretly despises you more than anyone.
: That would make me very sad. But I’m willing to try either way.
: Then you’re already stronger than me. I don’t think “trying” is really in my blood.
: Yes, look at me and admire my effort. It’s all I really have going for me, after all.
: You say that, but I think you’d make just as good of an idol as Niki if you were ever given the shot.
scene saranoonwalk23
: M...Me?! No way. There’s not a chance. No way in Hell.
: I don’t know. You really pulled off that idol costume a while back. And I think a lot of people would say you look even younger than Niki.
scene saranoonwalk24
: N...Now you’re just trying to embarrass me.
: It’s working too. Your face is beet red all of a sudden. You really like being complimented, huh?
: Nuh-uh...
scene black
: A few more...wouldn’t hurt, though...
else:
scene saranoonwalk25
: A...different person, huh?
: Yes. But why do you look so reflective and melancholic after repeating that?
: It’s nothing...I just felt that way a lot when I was her age too. And if she’s going through anything even half as bad as what I did, it’s no wonder she feels that way.
: You mean, like with...how you were abused and all of that?
scene saranoonwalk26
: Sure...let’s go with that.
: I mean, let’s not go with anything. Just tell me what you mean without making it look like you’re keeping some sort of secret. Because this is exactly what Ami does.
: Then maybe Ami and I have more in common than I thought?
: Sara-
: Have her drop by the bar soon. Tell her you need her to pick something up. Or just that I want to talk to her if you don’t think she’ll find that weird.

: I don’t think she’ll find it weird at all. In fact, if anything, I think she’d be happy to see you. I just struggle to understand what you think you two have in common and why you can magically cure it.
: Now, who said anything about a cure? Sometimes, all a girl needs is someone who understands her. And I’m not saying I will. Just that I might.
: And in the worst case scenario where I don’t, maybe I can just do her hair again. She seemed to really like that last time.
: Yeah, well...she has a lot less to work with now than she did back then.
: Then maybe I’ll let her do mine. We’ll make a whole night out of it. And who knows? Maybe she’ll be completely “repaired” the next time you see her?
: Or maybe she’ll be begging me to marry you and kick Niki out of the house again.
scene saranoonwalk27
: Either way, I win.
: Now, please excuse me as I eat all of the pasta I am not allowed to have while my daughter is in the house.
: Your problems are so much smaller than mine.
: Oh, Akira...
scene black
: If only you knew...
Sara and I spend the rest of the afternoon gorging on Italian food while talking about parenting.
I hate it.
But I like her...
So that makes it mostly okay.
And when I drop her off at the bar and the see the light reflecting off of the same silver necklace she always keeps draped around her neck, there’s a thought that makes me like her even more.
But it’s a depressing one, for it paints a picture I’m not sure I’ll ever see.
It involves the sun, the window in my bedroom, and her facing the mirror as she puts it on in the morning.
I wonder what life would be like if she were the one I grew up with?
